subject: 1. THE INTERNATIONAL ICE PATROL BROADCAST SERVICES FOR THE 1998
text:
1. THE INTERNATIONAL ICE PATROL BROADCAST SERVICES FOR THE 1998
   SEASON WILL TERMINATE 311200Z JUL.
2. AFTER 31 JUL, VESSELS ARE REQUESTED TO CONTINUE TO SEND REPORTS
   OF ICE SIGHTINGS SOUTH OF 52-00N TO COMINTICEPAT GROTON CT. ALL
   OTHER ICE SIGHTINGS AND REQUESTS FOR ICE INFORMATION SHOULD BE
   ADDRESSED FOR ACTION TO NIMA NAVSAFETY BETHESDA MD, OR ICE CENTRAL
   OTTAWA ON CAN, WITH INFO COPY TO COMINTICEPAT GROTON CT, AND
   NAVLANTMETOCCEN NORFOLK VA.
3. REPORTS OF ICE SIGHTINGS ARE DESIRED IN PLAIN LANGUAGE FORM.
4. MARINERS ARE STILL ADVISED TO USE EXTREME CAUTION WHEN
   NAVIGATING NEAR THE GRAND BANKS.
5. CANCEL HYDROLANT 274/98.

subject: 1. THE INTERNATIONAL MARITIME ORGANIZATION (IMO) HAS ADOPTED A
text:
1. THE INTERNATIONAL MARITIME ORGANIZATION (IMO) HAS ADOPTED A
   NEW TWO-WAY ROUTE FOR THE BONIFACIO STRAIT FOR VESSELS OF
   OVER 20 METERS IN LENGTH, AND A MANDATORY SHIP REPORTING
   SYSTEM FOR VESSELS OF 300 GROSS TONS AND OVER, EFFECTIVE
   010001Z DEC. THE REPORTING SYSTEM IS EFFECTIVE WITHIN A 20
   MILE RADIUS OF BONIFACIO (41-23.4N 009-09.6E). AN INFORMATION
   REPORT SHOULD BE PASSED TO BONIFACIO TRAFFIC ON VHF CHANNELS
   10 OR 16 PRIOR TO ENTERING THE SHIP REPORTING AREA IN THE
   FOLLOWING FORMAT:
   A. NAME-CALL SIGN-NATIONALITY-MMSI NUMBER.
   C. TIME AND POSITION.
   E. COURSE.
   F. SPEED.
   O. DRAFT.
   P. CARGO.
   Q. DEFECTS OR DAMAGE.
   R. POLLUTION INCIDENT OR LOSS OF CARGO.
2. CORRECTIONS FOR THE AFFECTED CHARTS ARE FORTHCOMING. LOCAL
   AUTHORITIES MAY BE CONSULTED FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.
